items.headline: Gale Watch issued October 15 at 2:16PM EDT until October 19 at 6:00AM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...North winds 25 to 35 kt with gusts up to 45 kt and seas
6 to 12 ft possible.

* WHERE...Portions of Atlantic coastal waters.

* WHEN...From Saturday morning through late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...Strong winds can cause hazardous seas which could
capsize or damage vessels and reduce visibility.
items.instruction:
Mariners should consider altering plans to avoid possible
hazardous conditions.  Remain in port, seek safe harbor, alter
course, and/or secure the vessel for severe wind and seas.
